items.text:
I do really enjoy the game and can play it for hours. However, the fact that I have to make sure I save every 5-10 minutes just so I don't lose a ton of progress due to bugs or just random jank is a big issue. If they had focused on bug fixes and improving the issues that are in the content already I feel like I could recommend it more to others.

I stopped playing after logging over 100 hours due to the fire update in EA, it made the game unplayable really with the amount of issues it came with. They seem to be pushing adding more content but the base of the game is just lacking so adding the extras is just like putting glitter on dirt.

Its fine to play right now but I've already had save files corrupted and deaths due to bugs/random AI. This is during the 30 hours I have put in after release. My character will still walk out into space with no helmet on which was supposed to be fixed a while ago and storage has to all be done manually. Your items don't get registered properly whether that is during task or otherwise: Batteries will be taken out of the chargers for no reason, they will stop doing everything after swapping batteries when needed and wont restart the tasks, refuses to stack items in bags and just goes one by one, character is highly unreliable I cant even get other crew due to the issues I have with one.

Its not player friendly. It can be played but I don't think majority of gamers would enjoy this game especially not as is. It can be fun but once you get killed from your ship randomly going hyper speed for no reason it becomes annoying. If they fixed the UI and focused more on the original content I think it would be worth playing. I cant recommend it in its current state. They do do regular fixes but they also add more problems by adding more content. I haven't tried the bounty system or races because I'm not confident they even work.

Buy it if you can stand jank and slog. Otherwise stay away for a few more years until its either fully threshed out or development quits.
items.text_zh:
我真的很喜欢这款游戏，可以玩上好几个小时。然而，我必须确保每5到10分钟就保存一次，以免因为bug或随机的故障而丢失大量进度，这是个很大的问题。如果他们专注于修复bug并改进现有内容中的问题，我觉得我会更愿意推荐给别人。

在早期访问的火焰更新后，我玩了超过100小时就停止玩了，它带来的大量问题真的让游戏变得没法玩。他们似乎在推动添加更多内容，但游戏的基础本身就很欠缺，所以添加额外内容就像是在泥土上撒亮片。

现在玩起来还行，但我已经遇到过存档损坏以及因bug/随机AI导致的死亡。这是在我发布后投入的30小时里发生的。我的角色仍然会不戴头盔走进太空，这本来早就该修复了，而且存储必须全部手动完成。你的物品无法正确注册，无论是在任务中还是其他情况下：电池会无缘无故从充电器中被取出，在需要时更换电池后它们会停止做所有事情，不会重新开始任务，拒绝将物品堆叠在包里，只是一件一件地放，角色非常不可靠，我甚至无法获得其他船员，因为我在一个角色上就遇到了这些问题。

它对玩家不友好。可以玩，但我认为大多数玩家不会喜欢这款游戏，尤其是现在这个样子。它可能很有趣，但一旦你的飞船无缘无故突然超高速飞行导致你死亡，就变得很烦人。如果他们修复了UI并更专注于原有内容，我认为它值得一玩。在目前的状态下我无法推荐它。他们确实定期修复，但同时也通过添加更多内容带来了更多问题。我还没试过赏金系统或竞速，因为我不确定它们是否能正常工作。

如果你能忍受故障和苦差事就买吧。否则再等几年，直到它要么完全打磨好，要么开发停止。

observations.description: 因bug或随机卡顿导致死亡

items.text:
This can be fun but you'll need a browser open to figure things out. There are also a variety of bugs.

To be fair cobbling together a ship and flying around are fun!

I had fun derping around in the early game but my first reload was the tutorial ship smashing into the planet's surface. I also have had several reloads from the space suit helmet seemingly not sealing and leading to dying with full battery, O2, and filters.
 
Things that I needed to look up:
Proper O2 pressure (over 20)
How to hook up sensors and panels (I had gotten it but there really isn't any major UI indication)
How to bulk order tasks (maybe just daft there but there are several steps)

Also lots of time just staring at the game trying to find what I missed

I don’t think I’m going to make it to late game simply because (apart from flying around) other games, like ONI, have more interesting ways of presenting the same struggles for me personally.
items.text_zh:
这可以很好玩，但你需要开着浏览器才能搞清楚事情。而且还有各种各样的bug。

平心而论，拼凑一艘飞船并四处飞行是很好玩的！

我在游戏早期到处瞎搞玩得很开心，但我的第一次重新读档是教学飞船撞上了行星表面。我还因为宇航服头盔似乎没有密封，导致在电池、氧气和过滤器全满的情况下死亡而重新读档了好几次。

我不得不去查的东西：
正确的氧气压力（超过20）
如何连接传感器和面板（我搞定了，但真的没有任何主要的UI提示）
如何批量订购任务（也许只是我笨，但有好几个步骤）

还有大量时间只是盯着游戏，试图找出我漏掉了什么

我觉得我大概到不了游戏后期，仅仅是因为（除了四处飞行之外）其他游戏，比如《缺氧》，对我个人来说有更有趣的方式来呈现同样的挣扎。

observations.evidence: my first reload was the tutorial ship smashing into the planet's surface

items.text:
I love the game, but it's simply far too buggy to recommend at this time. 

Expanding your ship? Die of hypoxia! Standing around the station? Blacking out due to high G-force! 
Constant stuttering/lag, sometimes items will just disappear, sometimes saves will just break, sometimes ships will just rotate wildly or disappear and sometimes NPC's will just die for no reason.

EDIT; i've changed to positive, as a lot of bugs are being ironed out, and the UI is actually being improved. although i would still wait until after EA.

items.text:
OK, so updating review but keeping old text below for accuracy. 

It's had some work, and I'm getting no crashes or 'jank' beyond needing to save and reload after long 6 hours play sessions and odd crew behaviour emerging. 

It's got me. It's bitten me good and I'm trapped. I got my first reactor set up from salvaged parts, of a derelict I found and restored. I got jumped twice and had to kill someone by stripping them of a space suit in vacuum and just...waiting. Then I saved someone on a derelict and I hired them on as crew. 

It's got its quirks, and it's not for everyone - but that's a good thing. If your looking at it and thinking 'yeah, I like the style, the vibe, the hardcore nature' I'd say do it. Or at least wishlist it. 

There are still some things that I think need polish or working on, but yeah. I'm hooked. ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. I literally go to bed thinking of ship layouts.

Great concept but it needs alot of work. 

Had to restart 3 times due to hardlocking or crashing Twice my ship just exploded upon undocking, the game couldnt do all the simulation but trash suddenly appeared everywhere and the game froze. I had touched the flight controls but mostly out habit. If the game cant handle that, dont let the player do it. 

Final crash was when i got pulled over by police, negotiated a warning, and then when I went back to my ship - we undocked automatically I think while i was stilly walking over. Character vanished, camera just started spinning, log showed I was taking damage, died. 

When it does work its a fun game, cool concept, art style is good but its really hard to tell what your looking at most of the time. Which is a bummer. Got legit locked in my room early game because I couldnt 'see' the rack it was pointing me at. 

Finally, when I did scrap two ships, i got back, sold my haul, and discovered I'd not scrapped the 'right stuff' because the $300 i made did not cover the $500 dollar docking fee. I'd have taken more scrap, but the ship I got was tiny. So I couldn't fit anything. The ship in the character before that, had chunks missing, didnt hold pressure, all the alarms going off. So that was also a restart.
items.text_zh:
好吧，所以更新评测，但为了准确起见保留下面的旧文本。

它经历了一些改动，除了在长时间6小时游戏后需要保存并重新加载，以及奇怪的船员行为出现之外，我没有遇到崩溃或“卡顿”。

它抓住我了。它狠狠地咬住了我，我被困住了。我从一艘找到并修复的废弃飞船的回收零件中建立了我的第一个反应堆。我被袭击了两次，不得不通过在真空中剥去某人的太空服然后……等待来杀死他。然后我在一艘废弃飞船上救了一个人，并雇佣他作为船员。

它有它的怪癖，并不适合所有人——但这是件好事。如果你看着它并想着“是的，我喜欢这种风格、氛围、硬核本质”，我会说去做吧。或者至少加入愿望单。

还有一些我认为需要打磨或改进的地方，但是的。我上瘾了。♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥。我 literally 上床睡觉时都在想飞船布局。

很棒的概念，但需要大量工作。

由于硬锁或崩溃不得不重启3次。两次我的飞船在脱离对接时直接爆炸，游戏无法完成所有模拟，但垃圾突然到处出现，游戏冻结了。我碰过飞行控制，但主要是出于习惯。如果游戏无法处理这个，就不要让玩家这么做。

最后一次崩溃是当我被警察拦下，协商了一个警告，然后当我回到我的飞船时——我想是在我还在走过去的时候我们自动脱离对接了。角色消失了，摄像机开始旋转，日志显示我受到了伤害，死了。

当它正常工作时，它是一个有趣的游戏，很酷的概念，艺术风格不错，但大多数时候真的很难分辨你在看什么。这很令人失望。游戏早期我合法地被锁在我的房间里，因为我无法“看到”它指向我的架子。

最后，当我确实拆解了两艘飞船，我回来了，卖掉了我的货物，发现我没有拆解“正确的东西”，因为我赚的300美元没有覆盖500美元的对接费。我本可以拿更多废料，但我得到的飞船很小。所以我什么都装不下。之前那个角色的飞船，有缺失的块，无法保持压力，所有警报都在响。所以那也是一次重启。

items.text: Not much to really do currently. Take apart/fix wreckage, sell, rinse, repeat. And then die of a bug or something. This game could be really cool, but it suffers from the lack of anything meaningful to do at the moment.
items.text_zh: 目前真没什么可做的。拆解/修理残骸，卖掉，重复。然后死于某个bug之类的。这游戏本来可以很酷，但目前缺乏任何有意义的事情可做。

items.text:
Currently unplayable to me.   
I had high but modest hopes for this game having loved Neo scavenger and accepting it's significant quirks.  

The game relies on a very unfun mechanic to me, top-down and fps 2D Vacuum space driving, requiring you to deal with acceleration and deceleration on two axis. This can be ok on some games like top down simple shooters. But this is a rougelike and one accidental collisions can end your game. Then also you have to deal with small batteries that have a range of about 1 destination, you cannot buy them at the start and only have two, any makes driving and you'll run out of power.   

It's also extremely buggy right now, I died twice just leaving the start point on boarding my ship, unclear why. Installing my second battery also failed twice somehow installation got stalled at 35% and I could not restart it or find out how to finish it.

Maybe i didn't give this gave enough time to master the flight control, but honestly after almost 2 hours i didn't want to, i hate this flying method. 

I hope the game will change significantly, and if so I will change my review, but I doubt they'll dump the flying and it wouldn't make sense to dump the rougelike aspect..
items.text_zh:
目前对我来说没法玩。
因为很喜欢《新拾荒者》并且接受它那些明显的怪癖，我对这款游戏抱有很高但不算过分的期望。

这游戏依赖一个在我看来非常不好玩的机制：俯视视角和第一人称视角的2D真空太空驾驶，要求你在两个轴上处理加速和减速。这在某些游戏里还行，比如俯视视角的简单射击游戏。但这是个roguelike，一次意外碰撞就能终结你的游戏。然后你还得应付小电池，其续航大约只够跑一个目的地，开局你买不到它们，而且只有两块，随便开一开就会没电。

现在它还有极其多的bug，我在登船离开起点时就死了两次，原因不明。安装第二块电池也失败了两次，不知怎么安装卡在35%，我既没法重新开始，也不知道怎么完成它。

也许我没给这游戏足够的时间来掌握飞行控制，但老实说，快两个小时之后我也不想掌握了，我讨厌这种飞行方式。

我希望游戏会有重大改变，如果真是这样我会改我的评测，但我怀疑他们会砍掉飞行，而且砍掉roguelike元素也说不通。

observations.description: 刚离开起点登船就死亡两次，原因不明
observations.evidence: I died twice just leaving the start point on boarding my ship, unclear why
